measurements.origin: Natural Park of Montesinho territory, in Trás-os-Montes, North-eastern Portugal
measurements.equipment: Hewlett-Packard 1100 chromatograph (Agilent Technologies) with a quaternary pump and a diode array detector (DAD) coupled to an HP Chem Station (rev. A.05.04) data-processing station.
The analysis was performed using a LC-DAD-ESI/MSn (Dionex Ultimate 3000 UPLC, Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA, USA) as previously
measurements.data_acquisition: The detection was performed using 280, 330 and 370 nm as preferred wavelengths for DAD and in a mass spectrometer equipped with an ESI source and performed in negative mode (Linear Ion Trap LTQ XL mass spectrometer, Thermo Finnigan, San Jose, CA, USA)
